unrealized_interest_before.meaning: Stored unrealizedInterest field value before the new interest accrual.

total_assets_after.meaning: totalAssets() value after the new interest accrual and storeMarketState.

assumptions: The high-supply token pool is supported and has high utilization, allowing interest to reach the precondition state.
accrueInterest() and storeMarketState are executed as part of the normal protocol operation.
The interest component in totalAssets is the stored unrealizedInterest field.

unresolved.description: The unit for the interest and totalAssets quantities is not specified in the report; asset_units is used as a generic placeholder.

limitations: Other extracted impact i_interest_exceeds_106 is deferred and not formalized in this claim.
The attacker deposit action a_attacker_deposit is treated as context, not as a precondition.
The bit-truncation root cause c_bit_truncation is not formalized here.
